en.summary: Easier everyday use: clearer instructions, simpler settings and faster marks entry.
items: Clearer PDF saving guidance, Excel template first for an examination with no pupils, and visible marks-entry instructions.
One assistant name, Smart Assistant, and short descriptions in Help for the Smart School Guide and Help & Support.
Simpler Pupil Report Forms settings: only the options for the chosen layout are shown, and your choices are kept.
Press Enter in a marks box to move to the next pupil.
Examination grading shows a short summary, and first-time school setup is shorter.
Grading links now open the correct school section.
Small buttons are larger on touchscreens.
No change to your marks, grades, ranks or backup format.

sw.summary: Matumizi rahisi zaidi: maelekezo wazi, mipangilio mifupi na uingizaji wa alama wa haraka.
items: Maelekezo wazi ya kuhifadhi PDF, kiolezo cha Excel kwanza kwa mtihani usio na wanafunzi, na maelekezo ya kuingiza alama yanayoonekana.
Jina moja la msaidizi, Msaidizi Mahiri, na maelezo mafupi katika Msaada kuhusu Mwongozo Mahiri wa Shule na Msaada na Huduma.
Mipangilio rahisi ya Fomu za Ripoti za Wanafunzi: chaguo za mpangilio uliochaguliwa pekee ndizo zinaonyeshwa, na uchaguzi wako unahifadhiwa.
Bonyeza Enter kwenye kisanduku cha alama kuhamia kwa mwanafunzi anayefuata.
Madaraja ya mtihani yanaonyeshwa kwa muhtasari mfupi, na usanidi wa kwanza wa shule ni mfupi zaidi.
Viungo vya madaraja sasa vinafungua sehemu sahihi ya shule.
Vitufe vidogo ni vikubwa zaidi kwenye skrini za kugusa.
Hakuna mabadiliko kwenye alama, daraja, nafasi wala muundo wa nakala za hifadhi.
